module: Grid selector backend of the "BusRoute" Vue wizard. Describes via a descriptor the levels that have bus routes (scenario_scenariosLoader.getLevels('bus')) and, per level, the list of its routes, then delegates to ui/oneshotRaceSelector/core.createBackend(descriptor). All the public functions of the generated backend are copied into M.
notes: Routes have no id field: the route's displayed name (route.name) serves as the key, like the old Angular service BusRouteService for highscores and navigation.
The file exports no locally written function: the real API (functions copied from the backend) is defined in oneshotRaceSelector/core.
The descriptor provides level tiles (key levelName, number of routes), route tiles and details panels (level size, number of stops, difficulty, creation date).
